question.en: How fast did the winning car go?
question.zh: 获胜的汽车速度有多快？

sentences.en: How fast did the winning car go?
sentences.zh: 获胜的汽车速度有多快？

sentences.en: Once a year, a race is held for old cars.
sentences.zh: 每年都要举行一次旧车比赛。

sentences.en: A lot of cars entered for this race last year
sentences.zh: 去年有很多车参加了这场比赛，

sentences.en: and there was a great deal of excitement just before it began.
sentences.zh: 比赛开始前大家非常兴奋。

sentences.en: One of the most handsome cars was a Rolls-Royce Silver Ghost.
sentences.zh: 最漂亮的汽车之一是一辆罗尔斯·罗伊斯“银鬼”。

sentences.en: The most unusual car was a Benz which had only three wheels. Built in 1885,
sentences.zh: 最不寻常的是一辆只有三个轮子的奔驰车，它造于1885年，

sentences.en: it was the oldest car taking part.
sentences.zh: 是参赛车中最老的一辆。

sentences.en: After a great many loud explosions,
sentences.zh: 在一阵阵巨大的爆响之后，

sentences.en: Many of the cars broke down on the course and some drivers spent more time
sentences.zh: 许多车在途中抛了锚，有些司机

sentences.en: under their cars than in them!
sentences.zh: 待在车底下的时间比坐在车里的时间还长！

sentences.en: A few cars, however, completed the race.
sentences.zh: 不过有几辆车跑完了全程。

sentences.en: The winning car reached a speed of forty miles an hour--much faster than any of its rivals.
sentences.zh: 获胜的车时速达到40英里，比任何对手都快得多。

sentences.en: It sped downhill at the end of the race and its driver had a lot of trouble trying to stop it.
sentences.zh: 比赛结束时它冲下山坡，司机费了很大劲才把车停下。

sentences.en: The race gave everyone a great deal of pleasure.
sentences.zh: 这场比赛给大家带来了极大的乐趣。

sentences.en: It was very different from modern car races but no less exciting.
sentences.zh: 它与现代汽车比赛大不相同，但同样激动人心。
